$schema_note: Who's in it (feature plan v7 N10). The plugin reads each quest's script actors and listeners (Quest.QuestParams ACTORn and LOC_* constants naming an ENpcResident row, and Quest.QuestListenerParams) and counts a name as a recurring story character when at least 8 main scenario quests name it; generic names (lower-case words) never count. aliases join a name the game uses onto the character's own name (keys and names are English ENpcResident names); blocks keep a wrong match out. Never join an era name (the Crystal Exarch) onto the name the story reveals later: that is a spoiler.
